definitionZh: 视图-时线-设置 CSS 属性用于指定一个或两个值,表示对滚动端口位置的调整(详见Scroll 容器),其中一个命名的视图进度时序动画的主题要素被视为可见. 换句话说, 这使得您可以指定设置( 或初始) 的起始和/ 结束值来抵消时间线的位置 。
sourceDefinition: The view-timeline-inset CSS property is used to specify one or two values representing an adjustment to the position of the scrollport (see Scroll container for more details) in which the subject element of a named view progress timeline animation is deemed to be visible. Put another way, this allows you to specify start and/or end inset (or outset) values that offset the position of the timeline.
